verdict.rationale: Gram's documented model is generating MCP servers from your own OpenAPI/TypeScript source or governing a third-party MCP server you already run — there is no evidence of a pre-built catalog of hundreds/thousands of ready-made third-party app/API integrations comparable to a connector marketplace. The MoonPay case study mentions bringing 200+ existing internally-run MCP servers under governance, not a Gram-provided catalog to browse and connect.
